description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named 'PictureInPicture' that demonstrates the use of Picture-in-Picture (PiP) mode, handling layout changes, user interactions, and PiP-specific features such as actions and source rect hints.

classes.name: PictureInPicture
classes.description: The main Activity class demonstrating Picture-in-Picture functionality, including layout management, PiP actions, and user interaction handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, listeners, and default state based on intent extras.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Sets up PiP actions when activity becomes visible.

methods.name: onUserLeaveHint
methods.description: Automatically enters PiP mode if auto PiP is disabled when user leaves the activity.

methods.name: onConfigurationChanged
methods.description: Adjusts layout upon configuration changes such as orientation or screen size.

methods.name: onPictureInPictureModeChanged
methods.description: Resets UI state when exiting PiP mode.

methods.name: enterContentPip
methods.description: Launches a content PiP activity with specific bounds and aspect ratio.

methods.name: updateLayout
methods.description: Adjusts activity layout based on current configuration and mode.

methods.name: setupPipActions
methods.description: Configures remote actions for PiP controls and registers receiver.

methods.name: setupPictureInPictureLayout
methods.description: Configures activity layout for PiP mode.

methods.name: setupTabletLandscapeLayout
methods.description: Adjusts layout for tablet in landscape orientation.

methods.name: setupRegularLayout
methods.description: Configures layout for normal mode outside PiP.

methods.name: enterOnePaneMode
methods.description: Sets layout to single-pane with vertical orientation.

methods.name: enterTwoPaneMode
methods.description: Sets layout to two-pane with horizontal orientation.

methods.name: updatePictureInPictureParams
methods.description: Updates PiP parameters based on UI state.

methods.name: updateContentPosition
methods.description: Adjusts content position within the container based on user selection.
